import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import ref, main as impl, fuzz, bigcross
maxprod=0; t0=time.time(); n=0
for seed in range(200):
    rng = random.Random(33000+seed)
    nserv = rng.choice([2,2,2,3])
    natoms = rng.randint(6,10)
    L = rng.randint(4,7)
    mode = rng.choice(bigcross.MODES)
    req = bigcross.build(rng, nserv, natoms, L, mode)
    parsed = impl.parse_request(json.loads(json.dumps(req)))
    try:
        order = impl.build_product(parsed['atoms'], len(parsed['services']))[0]
    except impl.ComplexityError:
        continue
    if len(order) > 8000:
        continue
    got = json.loads(impl.compile_bundle(parsed))
    t1=time.time()
    expected = ref.compile_reference(req)
    tr = time.time()-t1
    if expected == 'E_COMPLEXITY':
        print('ref says complexity but impl compiled!', seed); break
    if got != expected:
        print('MISMATCH', seed, json.dumps(req)); print(json.dumps(got)[:300]); print(json.dumps(expected)[:300]); break
    fuzz.check_dfa(req, got)
    maxprod = max(maxprod, len(order)); n+=1
print('checked', n, 'maxprod', maxprod, 'time %.1f'%(time.time()-t0))
EOF
